title: Hogwarts Legacy
provenance: community consensus (AppleGamingWiki / r-macgaming / MacPlay), unverified by Highball Failure report with a crash dump from WaterWANG-1014 (highball-db#48, 2026-09-15).
notes: DirectX 12, so D3DMetal, and heavy. Under investigation with an M4 Max on macOS 15.7.7 (highball-db#48). The game crashes seconds after launch at fixed addresses on DXVK and on DXMT with -dx11, and once on D3DMetal. AVX advertised to the game was the first lead and the recipe sets it, but a run with AVX confirmed on still crashed on the DXMT path, so the cause is open. On D3DMetal with AVX on the game runs about 30 seconds then reports "Failed to initialize DirectX 12", cause not measured. CrossOver 26 users report the game running on this D3DMetal on macOS 15, so a working configuration exists. DXMT and DXVK cannot run the DirectX 12 build.

knownIssues.symptom: Crashes a few seconds after launch at the same addresses on DXVK, DXMT (with -dx11) and once on D3DMetal (reported on an M4 Max, macOS 15.7.7)
knownIssues.cause: not settled. AVX was the first lead and a D3DMetal run got past this point with AVX advertised, but a later DXMT -dx11 run with AVX confirmed in the launch log crashed at the same addresses, so AVX alone does not explain it
knownIssues.fix: none yet. The recipe keeps ROSETTA_ADVERTISE_AVX=1, harmless either way. The game's own log (AppData/Local/Hogwarts Legacy/Saved/Logs) and CrashContext.runtime-xml are the next evidence

knownIssues.symptom: "Failed to initialize DirectX 12. Graphics drivers may require an update" after about 30 seconds on D3DMetal with AVX on (reported on an M4 Max, macOS 15.7.7)
knownIssues.cause: not measured. Not a macOS 26 requirement, CrossOver 26 ships the same D3DMetal 3.0 on macOS 15 and the game is reported running there
knownIssues.fix: none yet, waiting on the game's log lines from the D3D12 RHI
